artworks.title: The Children of Niobe Killed by Apollo and Diana
artworks.description: Wilson's landscape carries Homer's and Ovid's slaughter — Apollo and Artemis striking Niobe's children while the queen's boast collapses into grief on the Theban plain.

artworks.title: Niobe and her Children
artworks.description: David's early history painting freezes the moment before the arrows fall — the mother who counted her children against Leto's two.
